intro: Timor-Leste depends heavily on oil and gas from the Timor Sea, saved in a large Petroleum Fund.

chapters.title: Oil fund
text: Money from offshore oil and gas fields goes into a savings fund that pays for most government spending. The fields are running out, so the country needs new industries.

chapters.title: Coffee
text: Organic coffee from the mountains is the main export after oil.

keyTerms.meaning: A national savings fund from oil money.

cardGroups.title: Made in Timor-Leste
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Timor-Leste makes and sells to the world.
